findings.detail: Queue Militia: food: no drop of ~60 on screen
findings.explanation: Cost table out of date: Militia costs 50 food, 20 gold in this game version (in-game tooltip on video), data/units.csv says 60. A shift-click queued 5 militia (5 Queue events at 21:46.588): food 465 -> 215 (-250) and gold 775 -> 675 (-100) in one frame, then cancelled one by one (DeQueue x5 at 21:48-21:50), each refunding +50 food, +20 gold; checked on the CSV and the video at 30 fps. The matcher looks for 5 x 60 food, so one food spend is left over.

findings.detail: -20 not explained by a replay event
findings.explanation: Part of the 5-militia queue at 21:46.588 (see that unmatched spend): with 60 food per militia in the cost table, the -250 food / -100 gold drop does not pair up with all five spends, so 20 gold is left unexplained.
